morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来专名整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。输入键保留小写，实际人名通常写作 Vivian。所列 IPA 为常见英语读音；具体姓名读音以本人为准。[Collins：Vivian](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/vivian)

senses.zh_definition: 〔专有名词〕人名 Vivian，中文可音译为“维维安”等，具体写法以本人使用的姓名为准。
senses.en_definition: A personal name used as a given name and also found as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang digunakan sebagai nama peribadi dan juga terdapat sebagai nama keluarga; lazimnya ditulis Vivian.
senses.nuances: 此处按人名处理，无法从孤立的小写输入确定具体人物。并非意为“活泼”的马来语形容词。英语中可用于不同性别；不能仅凭姓名推断性别或族群。马来语释义为编写释义。下列为称谓组合。[Collins：Vivian](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/vivian)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Vivian akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Vivian 女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Vivian will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Vivian dah sampai kat kafe ke?

etymology.historical_story: Vivian belongs to a European personal-name tradition associated with Latin Vivianus, derived from vivus, meaning alive. Medieval records preserve related forms, showing a history older than its present international use. This background explains the name's ancestry, but it does not give every bearer a particular personality, gender, religion, or ethnic identity. [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2015/2/name/Vivian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Vivian 先认作名字：正式场合可听到 Puan Vivian；不要把名字的词源当作人物性格。
